mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns as capital becomes cheaper to deploy due to accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending capacity and leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) from their 3-month averages signals weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and producing negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline from prior 3-month averages (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO < 100), a decline in industrial production signals reduced output capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns due to lower corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high level of retail sales (RSAFS above 700,000) indicates robust consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 700,000 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 12-month year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 3.5% signals inflationary pressure that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL 12m yoy exceeds 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime (PAYEMS < 150,000), a decline in payroll employment signals reduced economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns due to lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS < 150000 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A high real interest rate (FEDFUNDS minus 12-month CPIAUCSL year-over-year inflation) exceeding 4.0% signals aggressive monetary policy, increasing discount rates for equity valuation and producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when real rate (FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL 12m yoy) > 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
